thread:
Mira (design): Quick design review — thinking about pinning the request ID so engineers can copy it easily from the drilldown. Sketch attached in Loom: https://loom.com/s/abc123
Raj (product): I like pinning, but where would the pin live on mobile? The drilldown header is tight.
Sana (eng-ux): Proposal: show a small ‘ID’ pill left of the timestamp. Tap to copy; long-press shows options (copy, share, open in new tab). Keeps actions inline.
Ben (eng-runtime): One question: if we add the pill, does it shift the trace breadcrumbs? We should avoid layout jumps. Maybe keep fixed-width header elements.
Olivia (accessibility): Important: pill needs an accessible name and keyboard focus. It should be focusable via Tab and announce "Copy request ID" with role="button". Also ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text.
Mira (design): Good call. Visuals: pill has faint border, bold monospace ID, tiny copy icon. Hover shows tooltip "Copy request ID". Does that break compact mode?
Sana (eng-ux): In compact mode we hide the small meta and show a chevron> that expands into a popover with the ID and export actions. That keeps density.
Arjun (support): If users export from that popover, we should include an explicit confirmation toast with a copyable link and the ID. Support gets a lot of screenshots without context — this will help.
Raj (product): Export CTA wording — currently 'Download' is generic. Options: 'Download trace', 'Export request (.json)', or 'Copy link'. Which do we prefer?
Mira (design): Leaning to two CTAs: primary is 'Copy link' (fast for support), secondary 'Export JSON'. Copy link is single action, less friction.
Olivia (accessibility): Ensure both CTAs are reachable by keyboard when popover opens. Also add aria-describedby linking to the timestamp to clarify context.
Ben (eng-runtime): Implementation note: export JSON should include correlation_ids array, stack_frames (truncated by default). We can stream large exports. Example CLI we could link to:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.com/trace/1976543210/export > trace.json
```
Sana (eng-ux): Thanks — for the popover layout I'll propose a 2-row grid: row one ID + copy button, row two CTAs. Keeps it compact and keyboard-friendly.
Mira (design): Copy microcopy: replace 'Copy link' with 'Copy share link' to avoid confusion with copying ID. Thoughts?
Raj (product): 'Copy share link' is clearer. For analytics, track which action they choose (copy vs export) — helps prioritize.
Olivia (accessibility): Microcopy tweak: add visually-hidden text on the copy button: "Copy share link for request {ID}" so screenreaders get the ID context.
Arjun (support): Can we add a small 'Report with context' option that opens a prefilled support ticket with link + selected stack frames? Would speed root cause triage.
Ben (eng-runtime): That’s doable but needs permission checks for private deployments. We can gate by org settings.
Mira (design): Ok action items: (1) Sana to update mock with pill + compact popover, (2) Ben to prototype export endpoint and confirm payload shape, (3) Olivia to write a11y spec for focus/aria, (4) Raj to add analytics events.
Sana (eng-ux): I'll push updated mock by EOD and include keyboard-flow gif.
copybot: Reminder: design checklist required for merge — include color contrast evidence and keyboard nav test cases.
Mira (design): Thanks all — will follow up after mocks. @Ben please ping once endpoint ready so I can link the cURL example in the spec. :thumbsup:
